reveal_rule: this file is the key.  open it only after visual_review_scores.csv is written; reading it first would make the review a lookup, not a judgement

same_for_every_arm: one candidate fill and edge colour
no smoothing, no resampling, no per-arm style
hidden_on_the_sheet: candidate item_id (it encodes family and role)

display_alignment.cost: symmetric chamfer, rotation only, coarse 3 deg then 0.25 deg refine
display_alignment.changes: the drawing, never a score or a rank
